{
  "decision-reconcile-independent-carton-witnesses": "WITH supporting_desks AS (
  SELECT n.carton_code, n.desk_code, MIN(n.note_id COLLATE BINARY) AS note_id
  FROM carton_note AS n
  WHERE n.finding = 'absent'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM carton_note AS p
      WHERE p.carton_code = n.carton_code AND p.finding = 'present'
    )
  GROUP BY n.carton_code, n.desk_code
), ranked AS (
  SELECT carton_code, note_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carton_code ORDER BY desk_code COLLATE BINARY) AS desk_rank
  FROM supporting_desks
)
SELECT carton_code, COUNT(*) AS witness_count,
       MAX(CASE WHEN desk_rank = 1 THEN note_id END) AS first_note,
       MAX(CASE WHEN desk_rank = 2 THEN note_id END) AS second_note
FROM ranked
GROUP BY carton_code
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY carton_code COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-reconcile-return-crates-by-model": "WITH contributions AS (
  SELECT batch_code, model_code, crate_qty AS expected, 0 AS counted
  FROM return_plan
  UNION ALL
  SELECT batch_code, model_code, 0, COALESCE(crate_qty, 0)
  FROM unload_line
  WHERE batch_code IN (SELECT batch_code FROM return_plan)
), totals AS (
  SELECT batch_code, model_code, SUM(expected) AS expected_qty, SUM(counted) AS counted_qty
  FROM contributions
  GROUP BY batch_code, model_code
)
SELECT batch_code, model_code, expected_qty, counted_qty, counted_qty - expected_qty AS variance_qty
FROM totals
WHERE counted_qty <> expected_qty
ORDER BY batch_code COLLATE BINARY, model_code COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-reconcile-split-fifo-lots": "WITH adjusted AS (
  SELECT lot_id, acquired_on,
         CASE WHEN acquired_on < '2026-04-10' THEN acquired_shares / 2 * 3 ELSE acquired_shares END AS shares
  FROM stock_lots
), inventory AS (
  SELECT lot_id, acquired_on, shares,
         SUM(shares) OVER (ORDER BY acquired_on, lot_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_shares
  FROM adjusted
)
SELECT lot_id, MIN(shares, MAX(0, cumulative_shares - sold_shares)) AS remaining_shares
FROM inventory CROSS JOIN stock_sale
ORDER BY acquired_on, lot_id",
  "decision-reconcile-transferred-finish-credits": "WITH changes AS (
  SELECT ticket_id, lane_id, award_pts AS points, slip_ref
  FROM finish_slips
  UNION ALL
  SELECT j.ticket_id, j.lane_id, -j.movement_pts, s.slip_ref
  FROM posting_journal AS j
  JOIN finish_slips AS s ON s.ticket_id = j.ticket_id
)
SELECT ticket_id, lane_id, SUM(points) AS adjustment_pts, slip_ref
FROM changes
GROUP BY ticket_id, lane_id, slip_ref
HAVING SUM(points) <> 0
ORDER BY ticket_id COLLATE BINARY, lane_id COLLATE BINARY"
}
